SELECT
    l_returnflag,
    l_linestatus,
    SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
    SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
    AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
    AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
    AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
    COUNT(*) AS count_order
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_shipdate <= '1998-09-02'
GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

SELECT
  o.o_orderkey AS l_orderkey,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
  o.o_orderdate,
  o.o_shippriority
FROM
  orders o
JOIN
  lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
WHERE
  o.o_orderdate < '1995-03-15'
  AND o.o_custkey IN (
    SELECT c.c_custkey
    FROM customer c
    WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
  )
  AND l.l_shipdate > '1995-03-15'
GROUP BY
  o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_shippriority
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate
LIMIT 10

SELECT
      n.n_name AS nation,
      YEAR(o.o_orderdate) AS o_year,
      SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS sum_profit
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%'
    GROUP BY n.n_name, YEAR(o.o_orderdate)
    ORDER BY n.n_name ASC, o_year DESC

results.sql:
SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
FROM
    lineitem l
JOIN
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE
    l.l_returnflag = 'R'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1993-10-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1994-01-01'
GROUP BY
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    c.c_acctbal,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment,
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC
LIMIT 20

            ```sql
    FROM supplier s
            ```
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    WHERE n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'
    AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate

        SELECT 1
        FROM lineitem l2
        WHERE l2.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
          AND l2.l_suppkey != s.s_suppkey
          AND l2.l_receiptdate > l2.l_commitdate
    )
    GROUP BY s_name
    ORDER BY numwait DESC, s_name ASC
    LIMIT 100

WITH part_filters AS (
        SELECT p_partkey
        FROM part
        WHERE p_size = 15 AND p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
    ),
    part_min_costs AS (
        SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) as min_cost
        FROM partsupp
        WHERE ps_partkey IN (SELECT p_partkey FROM part_filters)
        GROUP BY ps_partkey
    ),
    result AS (
        SELECT
            s.s_acctbal,
            s.s_name,
            n.n_name,
            p.p_partkey,
            p.p_mfgr,
            s.s_address,
            s.s_phone,
            s.s_comment
        FROM partsupp ps
        JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
        JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
        JOIN part_filters pf ON ps.ps_partkey = pf.p_partkey
        JOIN part p ON pf.p_partkey = p.p_partkey
        JOIN part_min_costs mcc ON ps.ps_partkey = mcc.ps_partkey
        WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
          AND ps.ps_supplycost = mcc.min_cost
    )
    SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment
    FROM result
    ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name ASC, s_name ASC, p_partkey ASC
    LIMIT 100

SELECT o.o_orderpriority, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) as order_count
        FROM orders o
        JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
        WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1993-07-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1993-10-01'
        GROUP BY o.o_orderpriority

SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'R'
  AND l.l_shipdate >= '1993-10-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate < '1994-01-01'
GROUP BY
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 20

results.sql:
WITH positive_balance_customers AS (
    SELECT
        SUBSTRING(c_phone, 1, 2) AS cntrycode,
        c_acctbal
    FROM customer c
    WHERE SUBSTRING(c_phone, 1, 2) IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
        AND c_acctbal > 0.00
        AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o)
),
average_balance_calc AS (
    SELECT
        cntrycode,
        AVG(c_acctbal) as avg_balance
    FROM positive_balance_customers
    GROUP BY cntrycode
)
SELECT
    cntrycode,
    COUNT(*) AS numcust,
    SUM(c_acctbal) AS totacctbal
FROM positive_balance_customers
WHERE c_acctbal > (SELECT avg_balance FROM average_balance_calc)
GROUP BY cntrycode
ORDER BY cntrycode

```sql
    JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE p.p_size = 15
      AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
)
SELECT 
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
FROM supplier s
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  AND p.p_size = 15
  AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
  AND ps.ps_supplycost = (
      SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost)
      FROM partsupp ps2
      JOIN part p2 ON ps2.ps_partkey = p2.p_partkey
      WHERE p2.p_size = 15
        AND p2.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
  )
ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey
LIMIT 100
```
